cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a senior project engineer/manager to join the Civil Engineering Group to lead the Water/Wastewater Treatment Team. This senior-level engineer will primarily be focused on water and wastewater projects, including treatment for projects located across domestic and international locations.
A typical work week includes team management, mentoring, marketing, business development, engineering calculations, design development, site visits, etc. This position requires interactions with owners, architects, contractors, etc. As well as proven marketing and business expertise.
Opportunity to work on premier projects nationally and potentially internationally. The firm has been involved in water and wastewater projects with the National Park Service for over 30 years and has traveled across the country and internationally for treatment related projects.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The following duties are illustrative only and are not intended to be all-inclusive.
Assist in master planning and conceptual design.
Assist in fee determination and proposal preparation.
Assist with monitoring design budgets and project schedules.
Serve as point-of-contact with Clients, Contractors and other design disciplines.
Manage multiple engineering projects from start of design through completion of construction.
Manage and mentor a team of civil engineers and CAD technicians.
Attend project meetings during design and construction.
Provide quality-control check of work produced.
Provide project construction administration support including shop drawing review, responses to Requests for Information (RFIs), and field observations.
Monitor project budgets and reviews and/or approves invoicing to clients.
Participate in collection and account receivable efforts.
Works overtime, when necessary.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
10+ Years of progressive civil engineering experience, including 8+ years water/wastewater treatment
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET accredited curriculum
Registered PE license in [Location masked] or ability to obtain one within 3 months
Min 10 years experience with PE license
Excellent time management and organizational and management skills with technical staff on multiple, simultaneous projects
Preferred Requirements:
Master's degree in Environmental Engineering
Knowledge or proficiency with Civil3D, FlowMaster, BioWin
Construction and operations field experience
Shows strong interest in participating in company initiatives

This senior-level engineer will primarily be focused on water and wastewater projects, including treatment for projects located in [Location masked], the [Location masked], across the [Location masked] and in international locations.
A typical work week includes team management, mentoring, marketing, business development, engineering calculations, design development, site visits, and regular contact with owners, architects, contractors, and others. This position requires ongoing interaction with clients and stakeholders, as well as proven marketing and business expertise.
There is opportunity to work on premier projects in the [Location masked], nationally and potentially internationally. [Company name masked] has been involved in water and wastewater projects with the National Park Service for over 30 years and has traveled across the [Location masked] and to [Location masked] and [Location masked] for treatment related projects.
cond_0438.responsibilities:
The following duties are illustrative only and are not intended to be all-inclusive.
Assist in master planning and conceptual design.
Assist in fee determination and proposal preparation.
Assist with monitoring design budgets and project schedules.
Serve as primary point-of-contact with clients, contractors, and other design disciplines, staying in regular communication throughout each project.
Manage multiple engineering projects from start of design through completion of construction.
Manage and mentor a team of civil engineers and CAD technicians.
Attend and actively contribute to project meetings during design and construction.
Provide quality-control check of work produced.
Provide project construction administration support including shop drawing review, responses to Requests for Information (RFIs), and field observations.
Monitor project budgets and review and/or approve invoicing to clients.
Participate in collection and account receivable efforts.
Work overtime when necessary.
cond_0438.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of progressive civil engineering experience, including 8+ years in water/wastewater treatment
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET accredited curriculum
Registered PE license in [Location masked] or ability to obtain one within 3 months
Excellent time management, organizational, and staff management skills across multiple simultaneous projects
Comfortable serving as a regular point of contact with clients, contractors, and project teams
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in Environmental Engineering
Knowledge or proficiency with Civil3D, FlowMaster, BioWin
Construction and operations field experience
Interest in participating in company initiatives
